name: Modal Sandboxes
description: Managed container-based sandboxes on Modal, isolated with gVisor.
descriptionZh: Modal 平台上的托管容器沙箱，采用 gVisor 隔离。
keyFact: Modal Sandboxes isolate agent code using gVisor plus Linux namespaces rather than hardware-level microVMs, and support GPU-backed containers with per-second billing; the platform is proprietary, while the modal-client SDK is Apache-2.0.
keyFactZh: Modal Sandboxes 使用 gVisor 加 Linux namespaces（而非硬件级 microVM）隔离 Agent 代码，支持带 GPU 的容器并按秒计费；平台本身为专有，modal-client SDK 以 Apache-2.0 开源。
caveat: Managed-only: no self-hosted option. Isolation is gVisor-based, which is weaker than hardware virtualization.
caveatZh: 仅托管、无自托管选项；隔离基于 gVisor，强度低于硬件虚拟化。
